test_title: PYST 192: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 9th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: M, N, O and P are sitting around a round office table. E, F, G and H have also joined the meeting. M is sitting opposite F and between O and G. P is sitting second to the right of G and third to the left of H. If N is opposite to H, then who is sitting adjacent to F?
solution:
**M, N, O and P** are sitting around a round office table. 

**E, F, G and H **have also joined the meeting. 

1. P is sitting second to the right of G and third to the left of H.

2. N is opposite to H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1797b04d1b7cb77bb918e243b6c0f041668cea90cfacd7f241ccd3765f186ef9.png] 

3. M is sitting opposite to F and between O and G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8c708d9a8c23b1351c21f0fafd51abb557282ce054cb7e7fff7f7030f2b9f20.png] 

As E is the only person left, E will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/265076690fdf213efe8a32165dfa8c987a00ca09dd1e64aad49bd38d7a7c2481.png] 

Clearly, P and E are sitting adjacent to F.

Hence, '**P, E**' is the correct answer.
